style.backgroundSystem: alternating seamless light-grey #ECECEC studio sweeps, white #FFFFFF sections, deep charcoal #1E1E1E claim bands, one full-width amber #F5A800 accent band, one misty steel-blue #2C3E5C chapter band reserved for the features chapter, and a grey-blue studio corner (wall meets floor) for scene shots
style.iconSystem: thin-line rounded-square outline icons with uniform #2D2D2D stroke on light backgrounds (white stroke on dark), plus amber #F5A800 square number chips with white numerals
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows only, neutral color temperature; flat even graphic lighting on pure infographic bands; raking side light reserved for texture macros
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimal light-business backpack ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of light grey #ECECEC studio sweeps, white #FFFFFF sections, deep charcoal #1E1E1E bands, amber #F5A800 accent elements, one misty steel-blue #2C3E5C chapter band, near-black text #1A1A1A on light bands and white text on dark bands; neutral temperature; modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines only; consistent thin-line rounded-square outline icons with uniform #2D2D2D stroke and amber #F5A800 square number chips; bright soft studio lighting with soft front-left key and soft contact shadows, flat graphic lighting on pure infographic bands; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale, centered upright placement with clean breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no brand logos, watermarks or QR codes
style.presentationRules: product centered and upright, stable front 3/4 hero angle reused across opening and closing shots; callouts always via thin-line icons, amber number chips, or short positional labels; numbered card layouts keep consistent margins and caption placement
style.surfaceSystem: seamless studio sweep and matte flat band backgrounds; grey-blue matte studio corner wall-and-floor for flat-lay and scale scenes; no reflective tabletops
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif (CJK-safe) short bold headlines; near-black #1A1A1A on light bands, white on dark bands; short labels and thin divider lines only, no dense body text
